channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Elon Musk Net Worth: How SpaceX and Tesla helped Musk become a trillionaire again after market rally
item.description: Elon Musk has returned to trillionaire status after a sharp rise in SpaceX shares, with Tesla also contributing to the rebound. His fortune climbed to about $1.04 trillion, highlighting how closely his wealth remains tied to market movements.

item.title: First Atlantic Hurricane of 2026 Seen Threatening US Gulf Coast
item.description: The US Gulf Coast will likely be hit by the first Atlantic hurricane of the year in coming days by a storm now gathering strength off the Mexican coast.

item.title: 32%, 24%, 52%, 86%: Why these 4 numbers are bad news for Trump before the midterms
item.description: The weak approval rating comes at a crucial moment for Republicans, with the November 3 midterm elections set to determine control of both chambers of Congress for the final two years of Trump’s current term.

item.title: Did you receive $90 from Social Security? Who qualifies for Trump’s Medicare rebate and when it will arrive
item.description: Millions of US seniors are receving a one-time $90 Medicare rebate through Social Security deposits. Here's who qualifies, why the payment was sent, when it should arrive, and why about 40 million Medicare enrollees are excluded.&nbsp;

item.title: US House bill honours Indian pilot Smit Machchhar after his brave actions thwarted flydubai terror attack
item.description: The resolution, introduced on October 5, honours Machchhar and the crew and passengers of flydubai Flight 1073, while condemning the attempted attack on the aircraft. The measure has been referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Trump’s ‘take out LA, San Diego’ remark: White House clarifies what he actually meant
item.description: The clarification came after Trump’s Nebraska rally remarks drew criticism from Democrats, a Republican politician and social media users.

item.title: ‘Layoff was a blessing’: Indian woman in Canada says job loss made her rethink life beyond 9-to-5
item.description: Semini Kulathilake recently took to Instagram to reflect on her experience nearly 10 months after losing her job.

item.title: This Indian state, with 112 billionaires and wealth of over ₹63 lakh crore, will impose water cut on its people
item.description: This state will implement water cuts starting 16 October, reducing usage by at least 10% due to drought in 74% of its talukas. Industries are required to recycle 30% of their water.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Longer but safer’ routes may beat speed: France says IMEC ‘more necessary amid Gaza, Iran, Hormuz crises’
item.description: France’s India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor envoy Gérard Mestrallet said Gaza, Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz risks have made IMEC more necessary. He said “longer but safer” routes could become preferable, with the corridor evolving into a resilient network of alternative routes.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Tremors felt in Delhi-NCR as 4.9 magnitude quake hit Uttarakhand
item.description: Earthquake tremors were felt in the national capital on Tuesday. So far, there have been no reports of casualties.

item.title: Russia denies anti-plague measures after lab worker’s death: WHO says ‘low’ risk — What we know so far
item.description: A 28-year-old woman, identified by Russian media as Darya Shipilova, reportedly worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East, a facility that studies dangerous pathogens, including plague. She died last week at a hospital in Shelekhov, a town near Irkutsk.

item.title: Could Bolsonaro's election win give Trump his biggest prize yet in Latin America? How big is Brazil's economy? Explained
item.description: Trump has built a Latin America bloc. Could a Bolsonaro win give him his biggest prize yet? How big is Brazil’s economy and resource wealth?

item.title: Jeffrey Archer’s India connection: Why the bestselling author released his new books here before Britain
item.description: Archer described piracy as a major problem in India. He said pirated editions of his latest books could reach the streets before legitimate copies were available in bookshops.

item.title: Nobel Prize 2026: How much is the prize money in Indian rupees, how joint winners split it, how the amount has changed
item.description: Nobel directed that more than SEK 31 million of his estate should be converted into a fund and invested in “safe securities”. The income generated from those investments would be distributed annually as prizes.

item.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai travel time to drop by 7-8 hours with Vande Bharat Sleeper: How it differs from Udyan Express
item.description: The proposed Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat train is expected to meet the longstanding demand of commuters who have been seeking faster rail connectivity for more than 30 years.

item.title: France PM condemns violence as school unrest spreads nationwide, says 'Burning down a high school does not improve it'
item.description: France's Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has condemned violence happening during the nationwide protests, as students, teachers and unions demand more staff. They are also asking for better buildings and improved conditions while clashes with police deepen tension.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi, other Congress leaders released after detention during protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: Rahul Gandhi and other Congress leaders detained during a protest against the Election Commission were released by Delhi Police after an over-eight-hour sit-in. The ECI said it had offered to receive their memorandum through an officer under its meeting protocol.

item.title: Banks told to expand digital lending, financial inclusion outreach: DFS secretary
item.description: The government has asked banks to focus on end-to-end digital loan processing, micro-enterprise credit and wider participation in financial inclusion schemes.

item.title: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit: Meet India's new Air Force chief who served in Operation Sindoor, Op Rakshak
item.description: Born on December 9, 1966, Dixit joined the fighter stream of the Indian Air Force on December 6, 1986. Over nearly four decades of service, he has held several operational, training and senior command positions.

item.title: US, China discuss visits to nuclear sites as fears grow that a new arms race could be taking shape
item.description: The US and China are discussing reciprocal visits to nuclear facilities, a tentative confidence building step as Washington worries about Beijing's expanding arsenal and the collapse of established arms-control limits between the major powers.

item.title: ‘Deranged and dangerous’, ‘He gave terrorists targets’: Trump’s Iran ‘take out LA, San Diego’ remark sparks outrage
item.description: The contrasting reactions have largely centred on whether Trump was literally suggesting that an Iranian attack on Los Angeles or San Diego was an acceptable sacrifice, or whether he was describing a hypothetical consequence of Iran acquiring nuclear weapons.

item.title: US trade deficit widens despite Trump's tariffs: What August data tells us
item.description: The trade shortfall rose 13.7% from the previous month to $105.6 billion, according to data released by the Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau on Tuesday.

item.title: Mumbai airport standoff: Govt puts Adani Airports' plan to shift international flights from T2 to Navi Mumbai on hold
item.description: Mumbai airport standoff: Govt pauses Adani Airport’s plan to cut international flights from T2 and shift operations to Navi Mumbai amid airline concerns.

item.title: From British Airways' 28,000-ft plunge to flydubai hijacking scare: Major Boeing aircraft incidents in 2026 so far
item.description: A British Airways Boeing 777 plunged 28,000 feet before returning safely to Heathrow, becoming the latest Boeing aircraft involved in an emergency this year. Here’s a look at major Boeing aircraft incidents reported in 2026.

item.title: Cabinet okays integrated transport planning authority, ₹10,000-crore SME fund
item.description: The government approved a ₹10,000-crore commitment to the SME Growth Fund (SGF), aimed at addressing the shortage long-term equity capital available to growth-stage small and medium enterprises (SMEs).

item.title: Flydubai ‘hero’ Indian pilot suffers skull fracture, memory issues; co-pilot may have intended to kill him | New details
item.description: The injury severely affected Captain Smit Machchhar's optic nerves, leaving his vision blurred. He is also experiencing difficulty recalling events, describing his memory of the incident as being 'in bits and pieces'.

item.title: IAS Tukaram Mundhe is a ‘rockstar’: Maharashtra FDA Commissioner shares NYT article about his drive
item.description: IAS Tukaram Mundhe has gained public admiration for his aggressive food safety inspections in Maharashtra, highlighted by a New York Times article.&nbsp;

item.title: Delhi traffic alert: Connaught Place, Parliament Street choke amid INDIA bloc march
item.description: Several major roads, including those around India Gate, Connaught Place, Parliament Street and Jantar Mantar, witnessed heavy traffic. Vehicles moved at a crawl as commuters encountered repeated stoppages and diversions imposed in view of the march.

item.title: West Bengal gets ₹29,000 crore UDAN boost: 4 new airports in 2 years planned; Naidu backs second Kolkata hub
item.description: West Bengal will get four new airports in two years under the Centre’s aviation push, with facilities planned in Chharra, Kalaikunda, Balurghat and Hasimara. The Centre also backs a second Kolkata airport, ₹29,000 crore UDAN investment and stronger international connectivity.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Gyanesh, it's done, bro': Rahul Gandhi climbs barricades during INDIA bloc march to ECI | Watch video
item.description: Rahul Gandhi climbed atop barricades during the INDIA bloc MPs' march from Parliament to the Election Commission, demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Gandhi later took a jibe at the CEC, saying, Gyanesh, it's done, bro.

item.title: Why Quebec separatism is back in focus after PQ election win, and what it means for Mark Carney
item.description: Canada’s Quebec separatism is back in focus as the Parti Québécois eyes a return to power and another independence referendum. The issue could test PM Mark Carney, especially as Alberta debates separation and Donald Trump continues his “51st state” rhetoric.

item.title: New GRAP rules in Delhi; restrictions in NCR October 2026: Know car fine amount if you violate regulations
item.description: For motorists in Delhi-NCR, failure to comply with the updated pollution and vehicle guidelines will result in substantial penalties.

item.title: Brazil Elections 2026: Who is Flávio Bolsonaro, jailed ex-president’s ‘more moderate’ son challenging Lula?
item.description: In the first round of the ballot on Sunday, Flávio exceeded expectations, taking 47% of votes compared with Lula’s 45%. Since no candidate won more than half the vote, the election will go to a run-off on October 25, when Lula faces an uphill battle to secure a fourth term and cement his legacy.

item.title: Chetan Bhagat's 4-hour workday pitch vs Narayana Murthy's 70-hour workweek: India's productivity debate reignited
item.description: Chetan Bhagat says four hours of dedicated work a day can be enough if employees prioritise effectively. His remarks contrast with calls for a 70-hour workweek, reigniting the debate over whether productivity depends on longer hours or better focus.

item.title: Crew goes missing after ship sinks in Black Sea Zone of Bulgaria following drone strike, says PM
item.description: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev on Tuesday (local time) said that the crew of a ship that sunk following a drone strike in the country's Black Sea Zone is missing, Reuters reported.
